narrative: Customer deposits are £5.65Bn (+8% this year) against £5.18Bn of loans — a loan-to-deposit ratio of 91.7%. £640M of fixed-term bonds mature from December to February. At 85% retention HTB keeps £544M and needs £96M of new money; at 70% it keeps £448M and needs £192M. Retention has averaged 78% this year. The £290M ILTR facility is the flex line.
